name: Agent Skills (open specification)
summary: The cross-runtime SKILL.md format standard that every other runtime record and every spec rule is measured against.

skillEntry.layout: YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content

name.charset: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only

description.purpose: describes what the skill does and when to use it, with keywords that help agents identify relevant tasks

metadata.shape: map from string keys to string values
metadata.purpose: extension point for properties not defined by the specification

contextBudget.loadingModel: progressive disclosure: metadata (~100 tokens) at startup, SKILL.md body on activation, bundled resources on demand

conventions.fileReferences: relative paths from the skill root, kept one level deep from SKILL.md
